build_wpo_loss: build a WPO loss instance with decoupled KL constraints for mean and stddev of a Gaussian policy
compute_wpo_loss_function: compute the Wasserstein policy gradient loss using sampled actions and Q-value gradients
compute_parametric_kl_penalty: compute the alpha-weighted KL penalty and dual loss for Lagrange multiplier adaptation
natural_gradient_adaptor: adapt a normal distribution to scale gradients by variance for natural gradient optimization
clip_wpo_params: clip WPO dual variable parameters to prevent log alpha values from going below the minimum threshold
